Week 22, September 30, 2026 in St. Petersburg

Week 22-- Red Herrings

Hi all!! I'm feeling lazy today so it'll be a short email. If you didn't crack the code from last week, you obviously didn't try hard enough. I'm staying in St. Pete with Sister Robison! Anyways, here's some highlights of the week :)

  • I have this list of words I love on a note on my old phone back home. On p-day last week, I had my mom send it to me! Now I finally have my list of good words!

  • Thursday night, the ZLs called us and asked what would be the worst that would happen if we were on bikes the next day. So we had a surprise bike day on Friday! I temporarily stole Hermana Hull's bike for the day because my bike tyre's falling off.

  • When we were on bikes, we briefly met someone who claimed to be God. I fully believed him, of course, but Sister Robison said he was high.

  • I'm going to be on car share again this transfer! The ZLs sent out a very confusing text with the info, so we're going to be biking on either Fridays or Saturdays.

  • I hit my five month mark on Tuesday! And Sister Robison hit her year mark on the same day!

  • General Conference is coming up! It's where we get to listen to sermons from the leaders of our church over the weekend. It's this Saturday and Sunday, so be sure to tune in! You'll be able to find it at churchofjesuschrist.org

Spiritual thought-- General Conference talk! I listened to this talk earlier this week, and it is amazing! I'd definitely recommend listening to it :)

Prayers for Peace by President Eyring https://www.churchofjesuschrist.org/study/general-conference/2026/04/19eyring?lang=eng

Enthusiastically, Sister Christison
